what_it_is: Comparison of Proportion of Gainfully Employed Special Needs Adults Pre- and During COVID-19 Pandemic

sections.label: Employment challenges for persons with disabilities
sections.summary: Persons with disabilities work in several sectors and face challenges such as needing workplace adaptation support, communication difficulties, and employer cost concerns.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Most persons with disabilities work in the community, social and personal services, food and beverages services, and professional services sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Some common challenges that persons with disabilities face in securing employment include the need for additional support to adapt to the workplace and difficulties in communicating with co-workers and supervisors.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Some employers are also concerned about the additional costs required to hire and support persons with disabilities, such as physical workplace modifications and the purchase of equipment.

sections.label: Job placement and employer support
sections.summary: SG Enable and partners placed over 3,500 clients from 2014 to 2021, and the Enabling Employment Credit supported employers hiring persons with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Between 2014 and 2021, SG Enable and its job placement partners helped to place over 3,500 clients in employment.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The Government also supports employers of persons with disabilities with the Enabling Employment Credit (EEC), which provides them with wage offsets of up to 30% for each Singaporean employee with disability earning below $4,000 per month.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In the first half of 2021, more than 5,200 employers hired more than 8,600 persons with disabilities with support from EEC.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Based on latest available data, more than 2,900 persons with disabilities were hired between September 2020 and August 2021 with support from JGI.

sections.label: Job and training opportunities created
sections.summary: Close to 300 job and training opportunities have been created for persons with disabilities under these programmes.
